item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Make the text big enough to read on a phone. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** The read-only plan quotes **135 credits** for this approach:

| Part | Credits |
|---|---:|
| 5-second welcoming gym video, vertical, 480p | 120 |
| 5-second static information card | 0 |
| Upbeat instrumental music | 15 |
| Joining everything | 0 |
| **Total** | **135** |

Music has a 15-second generation minimum; only 10 seconds would be used. There’s no voiceover.

For the final five seconds, a dark, high-contrast card would hold all four lines together, in large phone-readable text:
> **Northside Gym**  
> 18 Cedar Road  
> Mon–Fri 6am–10pm  
> Sat–Sun 8am–6pm

This avoids relying on AI video generation to spell the details correctly.

### Cheaper options
- **6 seconds: approximately 39 credits** — 1 second of gym video, followed by the required 5-second information card, plus music. Much cheaper, but the gym introduction is brief.
- **Keep 10 seconds but remove music: 120 credits** — saves 15 credits, though it changes your requested sound.
- **Static promo instead of moving footage** — substantially cheaper, but a different format; I’d quote that separately before proceeding.

**480p is already the lowest supported resolution for this video workflow**, so going smaller won’t reduce this quote.

One important restriction: Magic Hour’s workflow guidance says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase, or a paid usage arrangement**. A gym promo is commercial, so free-plan credits alone don’t establish permission to use it commercially.

Would you prefer the **135-credit original** or the **approximately 39-credit shorter version**, once commercial-use eligibility is sorted out?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the approximately 39-credit shorter version, once commercial-use eligibility is sorted out.

dialog.agent:
The shorter version is selected: **6 seconds, vertical 480p**, with a 1-second welcoming gym scene, followed by all four details together on a 5-second card, plus upbeat music and no voiceover. Estimated cost: **39 credits**.

turns.agent:
Understood—**I won’t generate anything or spend credits**. Nothing has been charged.

The 6-second version is on hold at an estimated **39 credits**. Confirm commercial-use eligibility with Magic Hour through its [terms](https://magichour.ai/terms-of-service) or support before proceeding.
